result.instructions: Tools for Senta, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the client Watchful Cobweb and show me their contacts."; "Which jobs are overdue for my clients right now?"; "List the clients in my Prospects client list.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Senta data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run senta_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run senta_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run senta_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. senta_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: senta_search_clients
tools.title: Search clients
tools.description: Find the practice's clients by keywords. Returns matching clients with their id (`_id`) and name (`title`). Use the id with senta_get_client, senta_list_jobs or senta_add_note. GET /api/clients/search.

keywords.description: Words to match client names against.

limit.description: Most records to return (default 100, max 1000). Senta has no paging, so this only cuts the reply.

tools.name: senta_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Read one client: name, state, type, business area, contacts (name, email, mobile, shareholding), address and the other fields the practice configured. GET /api/clients/{id}.

client_id.description: The client id (`_id`), e.g. c260af21ede8f, from senta_search_clients.

tools.name: senta_list_client_view
tools.title: List clients in a saved client list
tools.description: Read a saved client list of the practice (the same filter and columns as in the Senta app). The view id is the last part of the list's address: https://<practice>.senta.co/c/l/v08a361263f4a has the view id v08a361263f4a. Column names are the list's column titles (for example "Client name", "State"). GET /api/clients/{viewId}.

view_id.description: The client list (view) id, e.g. v08a361263f4a.

limit.description: Most records to return (default 100, max 1000). Senta has no paging, so this only cuts the reply.

annotations.title: List clients in a saved client list

tools.name: senta_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (id, client id `cid`, job template id `wid`, title and main date). Filter by client, job template or status (pending, ready, overdue, completed, cancelled). With no filter this is every job of the practice, so filter when you can. GET /api/jobs.

template_id.description: Only jobs made from this job template (`wid`).

limit.description: Most records to return (default 100, max 1000). Senta has no paging, so this only cuts the reply.

tools.name: senta_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: WRITE: create a new client (company) in the practice. A name (title) is required; the other fields depend on the practice's own client form. Returns the new client with its id. Check senta_search_clients first so you do not create a duplicate. POST /api/clients.

clientstate.description: State, e.g. "Prospect" or "Client" (the practice's own states).

extra_fields.description: Other fields configured by the practice (Settings > Forms > Edit Client), keyed by Senta's internal field name.

contacts.description: Contacts: firstname, lastname, email, mobile, shareholding.

tools.name: senta_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: WRITE: partially update an existing client; only submitted properties are changed, per Senta's Client API. Read current contacts with senta_get_client before editing them and pass the contact details to update or add. Changing clientstate or enabling a service can start jobs in Senta. There is no delete tool. PUT /api/clients/{id}.

clientstate.description: State, e.g. "Prospect" or "Client" (the practice's own states).

extra_fields.description: Other fields configured by the practice (Settings > Forms > Edit Client), keyed by Senta's internal field name.

contacts.description: Contact details to update or add, following the practice's contact form. Read current contacts before editing.

tools.name: senta_add_note
tools.title: Add a note to a client
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a client, optionally attached to one of its jobs. The text may contain simple HTML. Returns the note. POST /api/notes.

client_id.description: The client id (`cid`) the note belongs to.

job_id.description: Optional job id (`jid`) to attach the note to.

date.description: When the note refers to, ISO 8601 (default: now).

annotations.title: Add a note to a client
